name: 01 — Чёрный павильон
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup and precise product compositing. Create a polished, plausible Russian desktop landing page FIRST SCREEN, landscape 16:9, full bleed, no browser chrome or device bezel. Brand ДачаПар. This is an approval mockup of a real wooden sauna manufacturer promotion, not a generic template. Reference image is the edit target for the sauna's geometry: retain its construction, silhouette, correct doors/windows/chimney, texture and proportion, but extract it from the garden and change its exterior colour and setting as requested. Remove background garden/houses/trees and repeated diagonal watermarks from the scene, retain one clear ДачаПар brand in the UI. The whole page is one immersive scene with typography and prices over it, no separate photo card. Use bold elegant Cyrillic grotesk typography, excellent real website spacing, huge but readable headline and prices, very large CTA. Warm amber interior makes the product emotionally desirable. Keep all Russian strings and figures exact; no percentages, no invented specifications, no fake countdown, no extra claims about production deadlines. Primary CTA text 'Хочу баню по акции'. Price labels must say 'Цена вне акции', never 'было' or 'старая цена'. Required readable small print next to price: 'Скидки при заключении договора с 11.11 по 21.11.2026 включительно'. Add short trust footer 'С 2015 года · Производство в Вологде · Под ключ с гарантией'. Keep information hierarchy calm despite the dramatic sale style. Render the actual complete first screen, not a mood board.
VARIANT 1: THE BLACK SHOWROOM. Photoreal black cyclorama pavilion, charcoal satin timber Kvadro sauna exactly shaped like the reference, softly rounded rectangle roof, on the right two-thirds of page. Large realistic studio spotlights on left and rear-right, visible controlled beams through very subtle steam haze, warm glowing glass door and window. Dark seamless floor with subtle reflection, no excessive smoke. Palette ink black, warm white and acid yellow #e7ff40 only; sophisticated architecture campaign with loud Black Friday typography. Huge white 'ЧЁРНАЯ' above acid yellow 'ПЯТНИЦА' on the upper left, very slight bottom overlap behind sauna roof, letters remain readable. Smaller emotional line 'Снаружи чёрная. Внутри жарко.' Upper model selector 'Квадро' active in acid yellow. Compact lower-left dark price panel integrated into scene, label 'Квадро · 4 м · Комфорт'; thin struck-through price '430 000 ₽' labelled 'Цена вне акции'; main price enormous 'от 405 000 ₽'; yellow sticker '−25 000 ₽'. Below this primary yellow button. Separately an obvious small horizontal badge 'ДЕЛЮКС: ЕЩЁ −20 000 ₽', clearly a different package bonus. Show the bath very clearly with controlled grey edge light; wood must not vanish into the background. Product premium, warm, physically grounded. No snow, Santa or holiday lights.
